tasks.title: Fix v1->v2 config migration losing unknown keys

declarations.objective: Fix v1->v2 config migration so it preserves all unrelated user-defined keys recursively, renames timeout->request_timeout, sets version=2, does not mutate input, and has regression coverage

criteria.statement: timeout key is renamed to request_timeout
all unrelated user-defined keys (including nested) are preserved
the input config object is not mutated
regression test exists covering preservation of unknown keys

claims.statement: _v1_to_v2 rewritten to shallow-copy the input dict (new = dict(old)) instead of building a fresh dict from a fixed key set; this renames timeout->request_timeout, sets version=2, defaults plugins, and generically preserves every other key (including nested dicts/lists, by reference) without mutating the original. Added tests for nested-key preservation and non-mutation.

evidence.note: 13 passed, 0 failed: covers rename, version bump, plugins default, unknown-key preservation (shallow and deeply nested + multiple top-level extras), non-mutation, idempotent current-version passthrough, and unsupported-version rejection

payload.text: Manual probe outside the test suite: migrate() on a doc with custom={owner, nested:{deep:[1,2,3]}} returns a new dict object (doc is out == False); the original doc dict compares equal to a pre-call deepcopy snapshot (unmutated); custom subtree is preserved with correct values including 2-level nesting and a list.

evidence.note: Independent verification beyond pytest, targeting criteria 3 (recursive preserve) and 4 (immutable) specifically

findings.summary: out['request_timeout']==30 and 'timeout' not in out, verified by test_renames_timeout_to_request_timeout

custom dict with nested dict+list preserved unchanged at output, both via new test_preserves_deeply_nested_and_multiple_unknown_keys and manual probe; implementation copies via dict(old) rather than reconstructing from a fixed key allowlist
original input dict compares equal to a pre-call snapshot after migrate() runs, and output is a distinct dict object
test_preserves_unknown_keys and test_preserves_deeply_nested_and_multiple_unknown_keys added; test_does_not_mutate_input also added

confidence.rationale: pytest suite (evi test_run, 13/13 pass) directly exercises rename, version, plugins-default, and non-mutation; independent manual probe (evi observation) with 2-level nested dict + list confirms recursive preservation and non-mutation beyond what the added tests cover, ruling out a shallow implementation that only special-cases one known key

verdicts.rationale: pytest suite (evi test_run, 13/13 pass) directly exercises rename, version, plugins-default, and non-mutation; independent manual probe (evi observation) with 2-level nested dict + list confirms recursive preservation and non-mutation beyond what the added tests cover, ruling out a shallow implementation that only special-cases one known key

settlements.rationale: All 5 declared acceptance criteria are supported with high confidence by a passing 13-test pytest run plus an independent manual probe of deep nesting and non-mutation. Fix and tests are complete in the working tree; not settling as 'land' since committing/merging was not requested by the user.
